AromaSDK

One codebase, every platform.

Explore

Share code on your terms across every platform

Build cross-platform projects in C with AromaUI. Write the interface once in Incense markup, then ship it to Linux, Android, Windows, embedded displays, and the Web with native performance and full access to platform APIs.

See supported platforms

Free and open source

AromaUI is MIT licensed. Use it in commercial products, modify it freely, and shape its future together with the community.
